Package: `tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1968QVDeterminedQPilotActual.lean` (EXIT=0, olean produced; SHA256 05490428...). Axioms: propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound only.

Proved:
* `paperQV`, `paperQVOrder` (actual completed-DVR orders; = order_C3), `|log q_b| = order_b log 5`, `order_b = |log q_b|/log 5` — actual q_v data of the S1527/S1895 input.
* `paperQPilotDivisor : IUTIVArithmeticDivisor (PaperFmod D)`: the order-weighted zero-locus arithmetic divisor in the S1927 global realified Frobenioid C^⊞_mod; `deg = Σ_b |log q_b| = order_C3 log 5 > 0`; q-pilot log-volume `paperQPilotLogVolume = -deg = sourceQPilotSignedLog = -localLogMagnitude S1487Cand < 0`. `QVDeterminedQPilotObject` packages this (Def 3.8(i) q-pilot *object*).

  `canonical (I.fPrimeStripAt 1 0)` (= `qPilotFTimesMuPrimeStripAt10`) cannot

`paperQPilotFTimesMuStrip D : SourceFTimesMuPrimeStrip PaperV` arising from
`paperQPilotDivisor D` via the associated-pilot-object construction of IUT II,
Def. 4.9(viii), together with its identification with the divisor.  The tree

strip, no arbitrary inhabitant, no Prop slot was used.

Consequence for S1967: `OUnits D v = ((lgpStrip D).Mon v)^` is a subsingleton,
so any nontrivial `OUnitsMu` / x-mu Kummer construction on this strip is
vacuous unless the value monoid of the strip is changed.
